Deny Advantage.description: The burglar isn't off-guard to creatures of 4th level or lower that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, flanking, or using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w6rMqmGzhUahdnA7]{Surprise Attack}.

Nimble Dodge.name: Nimble Dodge
Nimble Dodge.description:
Trigger The burglar is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see.

Effect The burglar gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Mobility.name: Mobility
Mobility.description: When the burglar Strides half their speed or less, that movement does not trigger reactions.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
The burglar deals 1d6 extra precision damage to off-guard creatures.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SneakAttack]

Surprise Attack.name: Surprise Attack
Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, if the burglar rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to them.

Bethela.name: Bethela
Bethela.hazarddescription:
Magical Sundries

Bethela is seventeen years old, and recently returned from magical studies in Absalom.

Even though her family lives in town, she is accustomed to her independence and now rents a room from Alymora Inkleholtz.

In the mornings, she sells magical items from Wrin's Wonders and Odd Stories, and in the afternoons she tutors the Inlkeholtz children.

She is saving money to return to Absalom and open a magic item stall of her own.

Potion of Water Breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
Potion of Water Breathing.description:
Activate A (manipulate)

This filmy, gray potion smells of an old fish midden and tastes even worse. After drinking this potion, you gain the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} spell for 1 hour.

Artevil Suspension.name: Artevil Suspension
Artevil Suspension.description:
Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}

This dried herb is known for its ability to draw toxins from the body, albeit violently. You can administer the suspension orally, Activating the item as part of the same activity you use to Treat Poison. If you succeed at your Medicine check to Treat Poison against an ingested poison, you can reduce the stage of the toxin by one stage, though this can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the poison entirely. If you do, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} as its body purges the toxin. An artevil suspension doesn't work unless the poison was administered through ingestion; for instance, if a poison can be administered through either ingestion or injury and was administered through injury, the suspension won't work.

Seventh Prism (Triangular).name: Seventh Prism (Triangular)
Seventh Prism (Triangular).description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Beloved by the church of the Seventh Veil, a seventh prism is a crystal that disperses its internal light, casting an aurora of color. If you use a seventh prism to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UKsIOWmMx4hSpafl]{Dizzying Colors}, targets are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for twice as long as their saving throw indicates. On a critical failure, the target is dazzled for 1 minute after its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} condition ends. Motes of shifting rainbow hues cloud the eyes, making it difficult to see details.

Feather Step Stone.name: Feather Step Stone
Feather Step Stone.description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You Stride or Step

Requirements You are trained in Acrobatics

This stone, usually shaped as a cabochon, is a small chunk of amber with a bit of feather or a flying insect caught within it. When you activate the stone, you ignore the effects of any difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain you move through until the end of your turn.

Psychic Warding Bracelet.name: Psychic Warding Bracelet
Psychic Warding Bracelet.description:
This set of reflective metal wires takes 10 minutes to properly tie along the wrist's energy meridians, then repels attempts at mental manipulation. You gain a +2 item bonus to your next save against a mental effect after tying on the bracelet. After this save, the metal strands tarnish and fall off (possibly alerting the wearer or others that their mind has been tampered with).

You can remove the bracelet with an Interact action, but doing so breaks the bracelet's alignment and requires you to spend another 10 minutes to carefully tie it back on.

Alloy Orb (Low-Grade).name: Alloy Orb (Low-Grade)
Alloy Orb (Low-Grade).description:
Activate A (concentrate)

Although solid, this orb of metal swirls with bright silver and dark iron colors, as if made of liquid. When you activate the alloy orb, select cold iron or silver. The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material for 1 minute, suppressing its original material. This orb only works on weapons of 8th level or lower.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.9MU9d8tmJg3thkSc]{Effect: Alloy Orb (Low-Grade)}

Cantrip Deck (5-pack).name: Cantrip Deck (5-pack)
Cantrip Deck (5-pack).description:
In an effort to spread the knowledge of magic as widely as possible, worshippers of Nethys discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards accessible even to non-spellcasters. The deck contains thick parchment cards, each roughly half the size of a playing card. In precise, no-nonsense script, each card simply states the name of its cantrip, color-coded based on its school.

This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip.

Activate 1 or more (envision, Interact)

Effect You envision your desired cantrip, causing its card to rise to the top of the deck, and draw the card. The deck casts that cantrip as a 1st-rank spell, with a DC of 15 and a spell attack modifier of +5. The card crumbles into dust as the cantrip takes effect. The activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.

Healing Potion (Minor).name: Healing Potion (Minor)
Healing Potion (Minor).description:
Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points.

Healing Potion (Lesser).name: Healing Potion (Lesser)
Healing Potion (Lesser).description:
Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Hit Points.

Cloak of Feline Rest.name: Cloak of Feline Rest
Cloak of Feline Rest.description: This black velvet cloak is featureless and very soft to the touch. Upon wearing it for the first time, you're momentarily overwhelmed with a sense of comfort and coziness. While wearing this cloak you can comfortably rest in any space, so long as it's not wet or particularly hazardous. While sleeping in this cloak you only take a -2 status penalty to auditory Perception checks, rather than a -4 status penalty.

Everlight Crystal.name: Everlight Crystal
Everlight Crystal.description: An everlight crystal is one of the most common applications of permanent magic. This stone or gem sheds magical bright light constantly in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). The light requires no oxygen, generates no heat, and can't be extinguished, though the crystal can be covered.

Potency Crystal.name: Potency Crystal
Potency Crystal.description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You make an attack with the affixed weapon, but you haven't rolled yet

This fluorite crystal glows with a strange phosphorescence. When you activate the crystal, the weapon becomes a +1 striking weapon on the Strike and until the end of this turn, gaining a +1 item bonus to the attack roll and increasing the damage to two weapon damage dice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.R5ugeFK3MPwkbv0s]{Effect: Potency Crystal}

Reading Ring.name: Reading Ring
Reading Ring.description: A reading ring is personalized to its user and capable of reading only languages in which the user is fluent. Each ring is unique and can't be used by anyone other than its specific bonded user. A reading ring is bonded to its user in a process that taps into the user's inner potential, similar to an invested item, except the process takes 10 minutes, is permanent, and doesn't count toward your number of invested items. You can wear the ring in various ways, often either on a finger or a chain worn about your person if you can't have it on a digit. You can use the reading ring to read text by taking an Interact action, and you read with the ring at roughly the same rate as a visual reader. There is no limit to how often you can use the ring to read in this manner.

Runestone.name: Runestone
Runestone.description: This flat piece of hard stone is specially prepared for etching a magical fundamental rune or property rune. You can etch only one rune upon a stone. When a rune is transferred from the runestone to another object, the runestone cracks and is destroyed. The Price listed is for an empty stone; a stone holding a rune adds the Price of the rune.

Versatile Tinderbox.name: Versatile Tinderbox
Versatile Tinderbox.description: A fine case carved from elegant wood, this tinderbox holds twigs and strips of wood in a selection of six colors. In a typical versatile tinderbox, these colors are black, blue, green, magenta, yellow, and violet. When used in lighting a fire, colored tinder alters the flames' color and smoke to match. The box is perfectly carved and constructed to hold tinder, keeping it completely dry, but is incapable of closing if used to hold anything else. The tinderbox replenishes itself; it's never out of tinder when its owner is in need, but it never produces a surplus of tinder either.

Handwraps of Mighty Blows.name: Handwraps of Mighty Blows
Handwraps of Mighty Blows.description:
As you invest these embroidered strips of cloth, you must meditate and slowly wrap them around your hands. These handwraps have weapon runes etched into them to give your unarmed attacks the benefits of those runes, making your unarmed attacks work like magic weapons. For example, +1 striking handwraps of mighty blows would give you a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with your unarmed attacks and increase the damage of your unarmed attacks from one weapon die to two (normally 2d4 instead of 1d4, but if your fists have a different weapon damage die or you have other unarmed attacks, use two of that die size instead).

You can upgrade, add, and transfer runes to and from the handwraps just as you would for a weapon, and you can attach talismans to the handwraps. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons of the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes. Property runes apply only when they would be applicable to the unarmed attack you're using. For example, a property that must be applied to a slashing weapon wouldn't function when you attacked with a fist, but you would gain its benefits if you attacked with a claw or some other slashing unarmed attack.

Weapon Potency (+1).name: Weapon Potency (+1)
Weapon Potency (+1).description:
Magical enhancements make this weapon strike true. Attack rolls with this weapon gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon can be etched with one property rune.

You can upgrade the weapon potency rune already etched on a weapon to a stronger version, increasing the values of the existing rune to those of the new rune. You must have the formula of the stronger rune to do so, and the Price of the upgrade is the difference between the two runes' Prices.

Craft Requirements You are an expert in Crafting.

Clodia.name: Clodia
Clodia.hazarddescription:
Clodia's Clothery

Clodia is a clothier with a perpetual squint from a lifetime of up-close work. Her thick and expensive glasses no longer really help.

She carries clothing in a variety of sizes for small and medium creatures, and can make alternations to fit.

Clodia is a true artist, even if she has humble means. She loves nothing more to see someone beautifully clothed in her work.

Sack.name: Sack
Sack.description: A sack can hold up to 8 Bulk worth of items. A sack containing 2 Bulk or less can be worn on the body, usually tucked into a belt. You can carry a sack with one hand, but must use two hands to transfer items in and out.

Clothing (Fine).name: Clothing (Fine)
Clothing (Fine).description: Fine clothing, suitable for a noble or royal, is made with expensive fabrics, precious metals, and intricate patterns.

Clothing (Ordinary).name: Clothing (Ordinary)
Clothing (Ordinary).description: Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

Explorer's Clothing.name: Explorer's Clothing
Explorer's Clothing.description: Adventurers who don't wear armor travel in durable clothing. Though it's not armor and uses your unarmored defense proficiency, it still has a Dex Cap and can grant an item bonus to AC if etched with potency runes.

Gi.name: Gi
Gi.description: Also called martial arts suits or practice clothes, gi are outfits of tough cloth built for comfort and unrestricted movement—ideal for practicing martial arts. They have reinforced stitching resistant to strenuous use.

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.description: This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep magic armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Quilted Armor.name: Quilted Armor
Quilted Armor.description: Quilted armor is built in a long coat intended for defensive use without other armor. Quilted armor protects the upper body and legs, differentiating it further from the typical padded undercoat. This armor is frequently made in stylish colors or patterns to facilitate use as protective outerwear or a military uniform.

Dorianne Menhames.name: Dorianne Menhames
Dorianne Menhames.hazarddescription:
Also Crisp and Fresh

This stall is owned by Jala Highstepper.

Dori was sent by her father, the mayor, to apprentice with Jala Highstepper. She has been glum at the prospect, but reluctantly obeys.

Food - Fresh Vegetables.name: Food - Fresh Vegetables
Food - Fresh Vegetables.description: This is a single serving common fruit that is in-season for the area.

Drarda Hanley.name: Drarda Hanley
Drarda Hanley.hazarddescription:
Brelda's Bakery

When Brelda's son disappeard, her good friend and fellow dwarven matron Drarda offered to run her market stall while Brelda runs her son's inn.

Drarda is the widow of Trusk Hanely, the former Captain of the Guard. She fetches Brelda's baked goods every morning and is usually sold out in time for lunch. She is quite happy running the market stall, as helping Brelda has helped her reconcile herself with the loss of her husband.

Food - Fried Beef Pockets.name: Food - Fried Beef Pockets
Food - Fried Beef Pockets.description: Ground meat, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Fried Meat Pockets.name: Food - Fried Meat Pockets
Food - Fried Meat Pockets.description: Ground meat, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Fried Poultry Pockets.name: Food - Fried Poultry Pockets
Food - Fried Poultry Pockets.description: Ground poultry, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets.name: Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets
Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets.description: Ground shellfish, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Cheese Wedge.name: Food - Cheese Wedge
Food - Cheese Wedge.description: Wedge of cheese, sliced fresh from the round.

Hunk Highstepper.name: Hunk Highstepper
Hunk Highstepper.hazarddescription:
Hunk's Hunks of Meat

Hunk is Jala's younger brother. Together, they run their family farm and sell the output here on most days.

Jala hates the name of his stall, but he gets a kick out of it. He loves it when patrons joke about it as well, and will give a discount for a good laugh.

Food - Beef Skewer.name: Food - Beef Skewer
Food - Beef Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of pork, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Food - Fried Beef Pockets.name: Food - Fried Beef Pockets
Food - Fried Beef Pockets.description: Ground meat, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Chicken Skewer.name: Food - Chicken Skewer
Food - Chicken Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of chicken, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Food - Fried Chicken Pieces.name: Food - Fried Chicken Pieces
Food - Fried Chicken Pieces.description: 10 tenders of dark or white chicken, breaded and fried.

Food - Fried Poultry Pockets.name: Food - Fried Poultry Pockets
Food - Fried Poultry Pockets.description: Ground poultry, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Jala Highstepper.name: Jala Highstepper
Jala Highstepper.hazarddescription:
Crisp and Fresh

Jala Highstepper leads the Farmer's Guild, and always has a basket of things to sell. 

She does not open until late in the morning, and sells until midafternoon, before teatime.

Food - Fresh Fruit.name: Food - Fresh Fruit
Food - Fresh Fruit.description: This is a single serving common fruit that is in-season for the area.

Keeleno Lathenar.name: Keeleno Lathenar
Keeleno Lathenar.hazarddescription:
Lathenar's Pots

Keeleno is the owner of the marketplace and the nearby general store, and also works as a potter. His is a widower who has never gotten over the loss of his late wife.

Clay.name: Clay
Clay.description: This malleable, oil-based clay can be shaped by hand and is available in a variety of colors. A single unit has 4 ounces of clay.

Flint and Steel.name: Flint and Steel
Flint and Steel.description: Flint and steel are useful in creating a fire if you have the time to catch a spark, though using them is typically too time‑consuming to be practical during an encounter. Even in ideal conditions, using flint and steel to light a flame requires using at least 3 actions, and often significantly longer.

Leno Lathenar.name: Leno Lathenar
Leno Lathenar.hazarddescription:
Lathenar's Shop

Leno is Keeleno's oldest child and heir, and he is in a partnership with is father for ownership of this shop.

He has complete responsibility for and authority over the shop. He lives behind and above the shop with his wife, Debrann. The are expecting their first child.

Armored Coat.name: Armored Coat
Armored Coat.description: A custom, lightweight mail is fitted within the lining of a coat or similar apparel, physically hiding the armor while maintaining the wearer's fashion. While not nearly as protective as heavier armors, the armored coat allows the wearer to blend in more aesthetically during civilian functions. Like other suits of armor, the armored coat is custom-fitted to an individual's body type, ensuring comfort without sacrificing its defensive capabilities.

Buckler.name: Buckler
Buckler.description:
This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can Raise a Shield with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.

Hardness HP BT
3 6 3

Hide Armor.name: Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Chain Shirt.name: Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Wooden Shield.name: Wooden Shield
Wooden Shield.description:
Though they come in a variety of shapes and sizes, the protection offered by wooden shields comes from the stoutness of their materials. While wooden shields are less expensive than steel shields, they break more easily.

Hardness HP BT
3 12 6

Arrows.name: Arrows
Arrows.description: These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Bolts.name: Bolts
Bolts.description: Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Candle.name: Candle
Candle.description: A lit candle sheds dim light in a 10‐foot radius for 8 hours.

Oil (1 pint).name: Oil (1 pint)
Oil (1 pint).description: You can use oil to fuel lanterns, but you can also set a pint of oil aflame and throw it. You must first spend an Interact action preparing the oil, then throw it with another action as a ranged attack. If you hit, it splatters on the creature or in a single 5‑foot square you target. You must succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:10] for the oil to ignite successfully when it hits. If the oil ignites, the target takes 1d6 fire damage.

Sling Bullets.name: Sling Bullets
Sling Bullets.description: These are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

Arsenic.name: Arsenic
Arsenic.description:
This toxin is a compound of arsenic and other substances. You can't reduce your sickened condition while affected.

Activate A Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18]

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 5 minutes

Stage 1 [[/r 1d4[poison]]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 minute)

Stage 2 [[/r 1d6[poison]]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 minute)

Stage 3 [[/r 2d6[poison]]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 minute)

Animal Repellent (Minor).name: Animal Repellent (Minor)
Animal Repellent (Minor).description:
Animal repellent is a noxious alchemical substance that makes you repulsive to a certain kind of animal. You can, for example, make ape repellent, bear repellent, or snake repellent, but not a repellent that affects all animals. The repellent doesn't work on creatures that are similar to the kind of animal, but not actually animals—for example, bear repellent wouldn't work on werebears. Animal repellent is ineffective against animals with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, such as awakened animals. When you initially learn the formula for animal repellent, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, such as sea serpents, you must learn the formula for that kind separately, and it has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind.

You Activate animal repellent by sprinkling it on yourself or a creature within reach, or by spreading it on a surface in an area up to 10 feet square. The repellent lasts for 24 hours or until scrubbed clean with 1 minute of work (consisting of multiple Interact actions). The designated kind of animal can smell the repellent from three times as far away as normal.

The designated kind of creature typically avoids the coated creature or area, which smells foul and feels unnerving to it. If in combat or otherwise distressed, the creature can approach within 20 feet of the affected creature or area only if it succeeds at a Will save with a DC determined by the type of animal repellent. Once it succeeds at this save, the animal is temporarily immune for 1 minute. If the animal attacks in a way that causes it to taste or ingest the repellent, it must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:15] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

Backpack.name: Backpack
Backpack.description: A backpack holds up to 4 Bulk of items and the first 2 Bulk of these items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the pack rather than wearing it on your back, its Bulk is light instead of negligible

Chest.name: Chest
Chest.description: A wooden chest can hold up to 8 Bulk of items.

Sack.name: Sack
Sack.description: A sack can hold up to 8 Bulk worth of items. A sack containing 2 Bulk or less can be worn on the body, usually tucked into a belt. You can carry a sack with one hand, but must use two hands to transfer items in and out.

Alchemist's Tools.name: Alchemist's Tools
Alchemist's Tools.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks. If you wear your alchemist's tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

Artisan's Tools.name: Artisan's Tools
Artisan's Tools.description: You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, blacksmith's tools differ from woodworker's tools. If you wear your artisan's tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

Basic Crutch.name: Basic Crutch
Basic Crutch.description: Crutches come as singles or a pair depending on how much support you need while walking. A crutch fits under your armpit, and you use your hand and the swing of your arm to move with them.

Buoyancy Vest.name: Buoyancy Vest
Buoyancy Vest.description:
This canvas vest has been filled with cork shavings, tightly folded, and sewn shut. Wearing a buoyancy vest allows you to float in water with a lowered risk of sinking. If you end your turn in water while wearing a buoyancy vest and haven't succeeded at a Swim action that turn, attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5].

On a success, you do not sink, though you can still get moved by the current, as determined by the GM. The GM can also determine whether the vest is more or less effective in different weather conditions, raising the DC in rough waters or lowering the DC in calm water.

Climbing Kit.name: Climbing Kit
Climbing Kit.description: This satchel includes 50 feet of rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

Crowbar.name: Crowbar
Crowbar.description: When Forcing Open an object that doesn't have an easy grip, a crowbar makes it easier to gain the necessary leverage. Without a crowbar, prying something open takes a -2 item penalty to the Athletics check to Force Open (similar to using a shoddy item).

Doll.name: Doll
Doll.description:
Dolls are found throughout Golarion in a wide variety of forms. Among the most common are miniature painted figurines, plush animals crafted from fur and stuffed with cotton, porcelain dolls with fine clothing and silky hair, fabric hand puppets, and elaborate marionettes.

This price is for an average doll of any type.

Fishing Tackle.name: Fishing Tackle
Fishing Tackle.description: This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net.

Flint and Steel.name: Flint and Steel
Flint and Steel.description: Flint and steel are useful in creating a fire if you have the time to catch a spark, though using them is typically too time‑consuming to be practical during an encounter. Even in ideal conditions, using flint and steel to light a flame requires using at least 3 actions, and often significantly longer.

Formula Book (Blank).name: Formula Book (Blank)
Formula Book (Blank).description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

Grappling Hook.name: Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook.description: You can throw a grappling hook with a rope tied to it to make a climb easier. To anchor a grappling hook, make an attack roll with the secret trait against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. On a success, your hook has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the hook seems like it will hold but actually falls when you're partway up.

Healer's Tools.name: Healer's Tools
Healer's Tools.description: This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds. If you wear your healer's tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

Lantern (Bull's Eye).name: Lantern (Bull's Eye)
Lantern (Bull's Eye).description: A lantern sheds bright light and requires 1 pint of oil to function for 6 hours. A bull's‑eye lantern emits its light in a 60‑foot cone (and dim light in the next 60 feet). A hooded lantern sheds light in a 30‑foot radius (and dim light in the next 30 feet) and is equipped with shutters, which you can close to block the light. Closing or opening the shutters takes an Interact action.

Lock (Poor).name: Lock (Poor)
Lock (Poor).description: Picking a poor lock requires two successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:15|traits:action:pick-a-lock|immutable:true] checks.

Material Component Pouch.name: Material Component Pouch
Material Component Pouch.description: This pouch contains material components for those spells that require them. Though the components are used up over time, you can refill spent components during your daily preparations.

Musical Instrument (Handheld).name: Musical Instrument (Handheld)
Musical Instrument (Handheld).description: Handheld instruments include bagpipes, a small set of chimes, small drums, fiddles and viols, flutes and recorders, small harps, lutes, trumpets, and similarly sized instruments. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument (like a tuba) has greater Bulk. Heavy instruments such as large drums, a full set of chimes, and keyboard instruments are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
You can use a net either on its own or attached to a rope. When attached to a rope, you can use the net to Grapple a Medium or smaller creature up to 10 feet away (instead of only adjacent creatures). You can continue to Grapple to keep your hold on the target so long as the target remains within 10 feet and you continue to hold the net. The grabbed creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape unless you are adjacent to them, and it can attempt a @Check[type:athletics|dc:16|traits:action:force-open] check to Force Open the net entirely. Once the target is no longer grabbed, the net is unwieldy until refolded as a Concentrate action that requires two hands; if used without being refolded, Grapple checks made with the net take a -2 penalty.

When the net is unattached, you can attempt a ranged attack roll against a Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet. On a hit, the target is off-guard and takes a -10- foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it Escapes, and on a critical hit, it's also immobilized until it Escapes. The Escape DC is 16. A creature adjacent to the target can Interact to remove the net.

Crow's Casks.name: Crow's Casks
Crow's Casks.hazarddescription:
Crow's Casks

Crow's Casks sells ale, mead, and medieval junk food.

It never, under any circumstances, sells any poultry.

It also has several tables devoted to card games.

Magiloy will buy limited alchemical items, but only if it fits in with her current stock.

Agnar is an alcohol-free, stimulating hot beverage.

Mulling is a service to heat any drink.

Antidote (Lesser).name: Antidote (Lesser)
Antidote (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

An antidote protects you against toxins. Upon drinking an antidote, you gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 6 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7z1iY4AaNEAIKuAU]{Effect: Antidote (Lesser)}

Alchemist's Fire (Lesser).name: Alchemist's Fire (Lesser)
Alchemist's Fire (Lesser).description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 1d8 fire damage, 1 persistent fire damage, and 1 fire splash damage.

Bottled Lightning (Lesser).name: Bottled Lightning (Lesser)
Bottled Lightning (Lesser).description:
Activate A Strike

Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they are exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals 1d6 electricity damage and 1 electricity splash damage. On a hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Elixir of Life (Minor).name: Elixir of Life (Minor)
Elixir of Life (Minor).description:
Activate A Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain [[/r 1d6[healing]]]{1d6 Hit Points} and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life (Minor)}

Elixir of Life (Lesser).name: Elixir of Life (Lesser)
Elixir of Life (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creatures natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain [[/r (3d6+6)[healing]]]{3d6+6 Hit Points} and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.EpB7yJPEuG6ez4z3]{Effect: Elixir of Life (Lesser)}

Antiplague (Lesser).name: Antiplague (Lesser)
Antiplague (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

Antiplague can fortify the body's defenses against diseases. Upon drinking an antiplague, you gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against diseases for 24 hours; this applies to your daily save against a disease's progression.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.kkDbalYEavzRpYlp]{Effect: Antiplague (Lesser)}

Eagle Eye Elixir (Lesser).name: Eagle Eye Elixir (Lesser)
Eagle Eye Elixir (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

After you drink this elixir, you notice subtle visual details. For the next hour, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks, or +2 when attempting to find secret doors and traps.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VCypzSu659eC6jNi]{Effect: Eagle Eye Elixir (Lesser)}

Potion of Water Breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
Potion of Water Breathing.description:
Activate 1 Interact

This filmy, gray potion smells of an old fish midden and tastes even worse. After drinking this potion, you gain the effects of a 2nd level @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} spell for one hour.

Oil (1 pint).name: Oil (1 pint)
Oil (1 pint).description: You can use oil to fuel lanterns, but you can also set a pint of oil aflame and throw it. You must first spend an Interact action preparing the oil, then throw it with another action as a ranged attack. If you hit, it splatters on the creature or in a single 5‑foot square you target. You must succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:10] for the oil to ignite successfully when it hits. If the oil ignites, the target takes 1d6 fire damage.

Oil of Potency.name: Oil of Potency
Oil of Potency.description:
Activate A Interact

When you apply this thick, viscous oil to a weapon or suit of armor, that item immediately becomes magically potent. If the item is a weapon, it temporarily becomes a +1 striking weapon, or, if it's armor, it temporarily becomes +1 resilient armor. This lasts for 1 minute.

Scroll of Heal (Level 1).name: Scroll of Heal (Level 1)
Scroll of Heal (Level 1).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Scroll of Bless (Level 1).name: Scroll of Bless (Level 1)
Scroll of Bless (Level 1).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Cantrip Deck of Light (5-pack).name: Cantrip Deck of Light (5-pack)
Cantrip Deck of Light (5-pack).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}

In an effort to spread the knowledge of magic as widely as possible, worshippers of Nethys discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards accessible even to non-spellcasters. The deck contains thick parchment cards, each roughly half the size of a playing card. In precise, no-nonsense script, each card simply states the name of its cantrip, color-coded based on its school.

This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip.

Activate 1 or more (envision, Interact)

Effect You envision your desired cantrip, causing its card to rise to the top of the deck, and draw the card. The deck casts that cantrip as a 1st-level spell, with a DC of 15 and a spell attack modifier of +5. The card crumbles into dust as the cantrip takes effect. The activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.

Cantrip Deck of Stabilize (5-pack).name: Cantrip Deck of Stabilize (5-pack)
Cantrip Deck of Stabilize (5-pack).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]{Stabilize}

In an effort to spread the knowledge of magic as widely as possible, worshippers of Nethys discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards accessible even to non-spellcasters. The deck contains thick parchment cards, each roughly half the size of a playing card. In precise, no-nonsense script, each card simply states the name of its cantrip, color-coded based on its school.

This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip.

Activate 1 or more (envision, Interact)

Effect You envision your desired cantrip, causing its card to rise to the top of the deck, and draw the card. The deck casts that cantrip as a 1st-level spell, with a DC of 15 and a spell attack modifier of +5. The card crumbles into dust as the cantrip takes effect. The activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.

Beef Skewer.name: Beef Skewer
Beef Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of pork, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Cheese Wedge.name: Cheese Wedge
Cheese Wedge.description: Wedge of cheese, sliced fresh from the round.

Fried Potato Slices.name: Fried Potato Slices
Fried Potato Slices.description: Basket of crisps of fried potatoes, lightly salted.

Fried Shellfish Pieces.name: Fried Shellfish Pieces
Fried Shellfish Pieces.description: 10 tenders of shellfish, breaded and fried.

Fried Shellfish Pockets.name: Fried Shellfish Pockets
Fried Shellfish Pockets.description: Ground shellfish, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Fried Beef Pockets.name: Fried Beef Pockets
Fried Beef Pockets.description: Ground meat, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Shellfish Skewer.name: Shellfish Skewer
Shellfish Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of shellfish, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

yCvwZuIUfPtSf15b.name: Beef Skewer
yCvwZuIUfPtSf15b.description: Bits and pieces of pork, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Mug of Agnar.name: Mug of Agnar
Mug of Agnar.description: A hot, non-alcoholic beverage that will perk you right up. For more kick, try adding a shot of your favorite brew, or even whisky.

Mug of Ale.name: Mug of Ale
Mug of Ale.description: The earliest type of beer, and a favorite of taverns, everywhere.

Mulling.name: Mulling
Mulling.description: This additional service is simply to heat your drink of choice to the perfect temperature.

Full Meal.name: Full Meal
Full Meal.description: This is a filling meal that include a meat portion, a vegetable or fruit, a cheese wedge, a hunk of bread, and a mug of agnar.

Mug of Mead.name: Mug of Mead
Mug of Mead.description: An alcoholic beverage made from honey; more expensive than either mead or beer.

Osprey Club Store.name: Osprey Club Store
Osprey Club Store.hazarddescription:
Crook's Nookery

Yinyasmira's secret shop is only accessable to heroes who have earned her support, and who are also thieves.

If such thieves join her Osprey Club, they enjoy a 10% discount.

She will buy only items that interest her, and that seem of use to a thiefly type.

Thieves' Tools.name: Thieves' Tools
Thieves' Tools.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

+1 Glamored Leather Armor.name: +1 Glamored Leather Armor
+1 Glamored Leather Armor.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Climbing Kit.name: Climbing Kit
Climbing Kit.description: This satchel includes 50 feet of rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

Rapier.name: Rapier
Rapier.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.BznmPaRjI4Orb0IH]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

Qat.name: Qat
Qat.description:
Activate 1 Interact

The save for addiction to qat is @Check[type:fortitude|dc:14|name:Qat Addiction|showDC:owner], but the maximum addiction stage of qat never progresses beyond stage 1.

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:14|showDC:owner]

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 8 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to Reflex saves (10 minutes)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.rVFDLzYrJVYLiQBL]{Effect: Qat (Stage 1)}

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Flayleaf.name: Flayleaf
Flayleaf.description:
The flayleaf plant is relatively common, though the mildly euphoric effects of smoking its dried leaves increase when it's sourced from plants specifically grown to produce such effects.

Activate A Interact (Ingested, Inhaled)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:12]

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects (1 hour)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects (1 hour)

Stage 3 fatigued and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Stage 4 fatigued, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 hour)

Bloodeye Coffee.name: Bloodeye Coffee
Bloodeye Coffee.description:
A strong blend including several spices common in the Padishah Empire of Kelesh, bloodeye coffee is a favorite morning drink across the Inner Sea region. The maximum addiction stage of bloodeye coffee never progresses beyond stage 1.

Activate A Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:14]

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 8 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to AC and saves to which you are taking penalties caused by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Stage 3 can't recover from fatigued (1 day, after which the drug ends)

Blood Sap.name: Blood Sap
Blood Sap.description:
This potent drug is distilled from a certain tropical vine into a deep-red syrup that, over time, stains the user's lips and teeth a vivid shade of red.

Activate A Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:16]

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 3 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, +1 item bonus to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Acrobatics checks, and Athletics checks (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 hour)

Ghost Ink.name: Ghost Ink
Ghost Ink.description:
Activate 10 minutes (Interact)

This pale-blue ink dries rapidly, becoming fully transparent 1 minute after application. The ink glows red when exposed to heat, such as that from a torch or other open flame. This glow lasts only as long as the ink is exposed to heat, after which the ink becomes invisible again. The crafter of the ghost ink can alter the formula slightly to instead make the ink sensitive to sunlight, starlight, magical light, or heatless light created by an alchemical effect such as a sunrod.

While the text isn't glowing, a creature closely examining a surface marked with ghost ink can detect the presence of the ink with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:seek] check. On a critical success, they can make out the ink well enough to use Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}. One vial of ghost ink is sufficient to write a page worth of text.

Grit.name: Grit
Grit.description:
Activate 1 Interact

The save for addiction to grit is @Check[type:fortitude|dc:15|name:Grit Addiction|traits:virulent|showDC:owner], and the addiction has the virulent trait.

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:15|showDC:owner]

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to Athletics, Crafting, and Performance checks (10 minutes)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.e3RzlURndODzBnMt]{Effect: Grit (Stage 1)}

Stage 2 +1 item bonus to Athletics, Crafting, and Performance checks, -2 item penalty to Perception checks (1 hour)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.4aSqtBgvQr2TI3XT]{Effect: Grit (Stage 2)}

Stage 3 -4 item penalty to Perception checks (1 hour)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ZV9rtVOD1eDTwcY4]{Effect: Grit (Stage 3)}

Stage 4 as stage 3 (1 hour)

Stage 5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confusion} (1 round)

Stage 6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (remaining duration)

Missive Mint.name: Missive Mint
Missive Mint.description:
Activate 1 Interact

This white mint with a chalky coating appears to be a normal candy unless someone examining it succeeds at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:15] check to Identify Alchemy. If the crafter has the powerful alchemy class feature, this DC is their class DC instead, if it's higher. The mint's crafter can imbue a missive mint with a message containing up to 25 words while creating it. Someone who consumes the missive mint hears the message in a fizzing voice as the mint's coating bubbles away, which takes the same amount of time as it would to speak the message. The mint's eater has no way of knowing who the original sender was, what they sound like, or who the message was intended for.

Antidote (Lesser).name: Antidote (Lesser)
Antidote (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

An antidote protects you against toxins. Upon drinking an antidote, you gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 6 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7z1iY4AaNEAIKuAU]{Effect: Antidote (Lesser)}

Bag of Holding (Type I).name: Bag of Holding (Type I)
Bag of Holding (Type I).description:
Though it appears to be a cloth sack decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a bag of holding opens into an extradimensional space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the bag of holding itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

You can Interact with the bag of holding to put items in or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living creature placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutes before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

Capacity 25 Bulk

Brass Ear.name: Brass Ear
Brass Ear.description: A brass ear is a short, flared tube with one end narrow enough to comfortably fit against the ear canal. When using a brass ear to listen through a door, window, thin wall, or similar barrier, if the barrier would normally increase the DC of your Perception check to hear sounds on the other side, the DC increases by only half as much as normal.

Compass.name: Compass
Compass.description: A compass helps you Sense Direction or navigate, provided you're in a location with uniform magnetic fields. Without a compass, you take a -2 item penalty to these checks (similar to using a shoddy item).

Tear-Away Clothing.name: Tear-Away Clothing
Tear-Away Clothing.description:
Usage modifies existing clothing.

Performers and criminals are both known to use disposable clothing designed to be torn off the body quickly and easily. This garment is loose enough to be worn over another outfit, including light armor. You can remove tear-away clothing with an Interact action. The price for tear-away clothing is to modify an existing outfit. If purchasing a new outfit, add the tear-away clothing's price to the outfit to modify it as part of the purchase.

Caltrops.name: Caltrops
Caltrops.description: These four‑pronged metal spikes can cause damage to a creature's feet. You can scatter caltrops in an empty square adjacent to you with an Interact action. The first creature that moves into that square must succeed at a @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:14|name:Avoid Caltrops] check or take 1d4 piercing damage and @Damage[1[bleed]] damage. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from caltrops takes a -5‑foot penalty to its Speed. Spending an Interact action to pluck the caltrops free reduces the DC to stop the bleeding. Once a creature takes damage from caltrops, enough caltrops are ruined that other creatures moving into the square are safe. Deployed caltrops can be salvaged and reused if no creatures took damage from them. Otherwise, enough caltrops are ruined that they can't be salvaged.

Disguise Kit.name: Disguise Kit
Disguise Kit.description: This small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and a few simple wigs. You usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the Deception skill. If you've crafted a large number of disguises, you can replenish your cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of your disguise kit.

Marked Playing Cards.name: Marked Playing Cards
Marked Playing Cards.description: A deck of marked playing cards appears to be an ordinary deck upon initial inspection but bears specific folds, colors, scratches, or other markings on each card that allow an informed user to know what's on the other side of a card. A deck of marked cards grants you a +1 item bonus to Games Lore checks or other relevant checks to gamble with the cards. You can determine that an unattended deck of cards is marked with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:seek] check. Determining that a deck is marked during play is more difficult and is typically determined by a Perception check against the dealer's Games Lore or Thievery DC.

Net.name: Net
Net.description:
You can use a net either on its own or attached to a rope. When attached to a rope, you can use the net to Grapple a Medium or smaller creature up to 10 feet away (instead of only adjacent creatures). You can continue to Grapple to keep your hold on the target so long as the target remains within 10 feet and you continue to hold the net. The grabbed creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape unless you are adjacent to them, and it can attempt a @Check[type:athletics|dc:16|traits:action:force-open] check to Force Open the net entirely. Once the target is no longer grabbed, the net is unwieldy until refolded as a Concentrate action that requires two hands; if used without being refolded, Grapple checks made with the net take a -2 penalty.

When the net is unattached, you can attempt a ranged attack roll against a Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet. On a hit, the target is off-guard and takes a -10- foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it Escapes, and on a critical hit, it's also immobilized until it Escapes. The Escape DC is 16. A creature adjacent to the target can Interact to remove the net.

Paint Set.name: Paint Set
Paint Set.description: This set of painting supplies includes paints, brushes, jars, a palette, a set of small canvases, and a miniature easel. You can refill your paint set with extra paints and canvas for 1 sp.

Piton.name: Piton
Piton.description: These small spikes can be used as anchors to make climbing easier. To affix a piton, you must hold it in one hand and use a hammer to drive it in with your other hand. You can attach a rope to the hammered piton so that you don't fall all the way to the ground on a critical failure while Climbing.

Puzzle Box (Simple) (Hollow).name: Puzzle Box (Simple) (Hollow)
Puzzle Box (Simple) (Hollow).description:
A puzzle box features moving parts, locking mechanisms, and other components designed to confound the user. Solving a puzzle box typically requires three successful DC 15 Games Lore or @Check[type:thievery|dc:15|name:Puzzle Box] checks to Open a Lock, though puzzle boxes come in countless configurations and themes, and the GM can determine which skills are appropriate.

A hollow puzzle box is designed to have an empty compartment in its center, allowing you to hide an object inside of the box. Only someone that solves the puzzle box can access the item within. A hollow puzzle box can hold an item of negligible Bulk no larger than 1 inch in diameter. Any puzzle box can be made into a hollow puzzle box. Doing so doubles the puzzle box's price.

Snare Kit.name: Snare Kit
Snare Kit.description: This kit contains tools and materials for creating snares. A snare kit allows you to Craft snares using the Crafting skill.

Spyglass.name: Spyglass
Spyglass.description: A typical spyglass lets you see eight times farther than normal.

Swim Fins.name: Swim Fins
Swim Fins.description: These flippers attach to your feet like tight shoes-donning or removing them requires three Interact actions. While worn, you gain a +5-foot item bonus to the distance you move when rolling Athletics to Swim, not when using a swim Speed, and you take a -10-foot item penalty to your Speed.

Alcohol.name: Alcohol
Alcohol.description:
Alcohol is a common substance available in stunning variety. The Price of a dose of alcohol depends on the specific beverage. You can't recover from the sickened condition from alcohol while affected.

If you fail a saving throw against alcohol other than initial saves, the affliction's stage doesn't increase; the only way to increase the stage of alcohol's affliction is to consume more alcohol.

Activate A Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:12]

Onset 10 minutes

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects (10 minutes)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, off-guard, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (10 minutes)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (10 minutes)

Stage 5 clumsy 2, sickened 2, and stupefied 2 (10 minutes)

Stage 6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (8 hours)

Stage 7 death

Tami.name: Tami
Tami.hazarddescription:
Fishery Sundries

Tami is the niece of Tamily. She is only fourteen years old, but is a very competent merchant. 

For serval hours every morning, Tamily joins her at the stall.

Shell Necklace.name: Shell Necklace
Shell Necklace.description: This shell necklace rests between the collarbones and consists of one palm-sized shell surrounded by a variety of smaller ones.

Fishing Tackle.name: Fishing Tackle
Fishing Tackle.description: This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net.

Fishing Tackle (Professional).name: Fishing Tackle (Professional)
Fishing Tackle (Professional).description: This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net. Professional fishing tackle grants a +1 item bonus to checks to fish.

Shark's Teeth Necklace.name: Shark's Teeth Necklace
Shark's Teeth Necklace.description: This shell necklace rests between the collarbones and consists of one thumb-length shark tooth surrounded by a variety of smaller ones.

Food - Shellfish Skewer.name: Food - Shellfish Skewer
Food - Shellfish Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of shellfish, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets.name: Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets
Food - Fried Shellfish Pockets.description: Ground shellfish, potatoes and peppers, tucked into dough and fried till golden brown.

Food - Fried Shellfish Pieces.name: Food - Fried Shellfish Pieces
Food - Fried Shellfish Pieces.description: 10 tenders of shellfish, breaded and fried.

Crook's Nook.name: Crook's Nook
Crook's Nook.hazarddescription:
Crook's Nook

Crooks Nook is a popular tavern offering brews, meals and fishing.

Patrons can either bring their own fishing rods, or use one of the rods on the rack between the fireplaces.

Yinyasmera will buy fresh fish, but only one bulk at a time, assuming each fish weighs one light. She will pay one silver piece per bulk.

Agnar is an alcohol-free, stimulating hot beverage.

Mulling is a service to heat any drink.

Drink - Mug of Agnar.name: Drink - Mug of Agnar
Drink - Mug of Agnar.description: A hot, non-alcoholic beverage that will perk you right up. For more kick, try adding a shot of your favorite brew, or even whisky.

Drink - Mug of Ale.name: Drink - Mug of Ale
Drink - Mug of Ale.description: The earliest type of beer, and a favorite of taverns, everywhere.

Drink - Mug of Beer.name: Drink - Mug of Beer
Drink - Mug of Beer.description: A lager, either light or dark, more expensive than ale.

Drink - Shot of Whisky.name: Drink - Shot of Whisky
Drink - Shot of Whisky.description: The good stuff, served by the shot. Beware; shot glasses sizes vary.

Food - Beef Stew.name: Food - Beef Stew
Food - Beef Stew.description: Hot and savory beef and veggie stew, from a pot that is always bubbling on the stove.

Food - Shellfish Stew.name: Food - Shellfish Stew
Food - Shellfish Stew.description: Hot and savory shellfish and veggie stew, from a pot that is always bubbling on the stove.

Food - Vegetable Stew.name: Food - Vegetable Stew
Food - Vegetable Stew.description: Hot and savory veggie soup, from a pot that is always bubbling on the stove.

Food - Chicken Soup.name: Food - Chicken Soup
Food - Chicken Soup.description: Hot and savory chicken and veggie soup, from a pot that is always bubbling on the stove.

Food - Beef Skewer.name: Food - Beef Skewer
Food - Beef Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of pork, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Food - Chicken Skewer.name: Food - Chicken Skewer
Food - Chicken Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of chicken, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Food - Shellfish Skewer.name: Food - Shellfish Skewer
Food - Shellfish Skewer.description: Bits and pieces of shellfish, potatoes and peppers on a skewer.

Service - Mulling.name: Service - Mulling
Service - Mulling.description: This additional service is simply to heat your drink of choice to the perfect temperature.

Service - Private Room - Double Bed.name: Service - Private Room - Double Bed
Service - Private Room - Double Bed.description: The is the rate for a room with a single double bed. Maximum two people and two small pets.

Service - Private Room - Single Bed.name: Service - Private Room - Single Bed
Service - Private Room - Single Bed.description: This is the rate per bed, for a room with two double beds. Maximum two people and two small pets.

Service - Shared Room Bed.name: Service - Shared Room Bed
Service - Shared Room Bed.description: Most shared rooms - or flophouse rooms - have a four or more beds per room. This is the rate per bed per night. Pets extra.

Zeek.name: Zeek
Zeek.hazarddescription:
Crow's Elixirs

Zeek is a good-looking young man who is assistant and apprentice to Magiloy the alchemist. He has an intriguing burn scar on his neck. 

He enjoys selling their less-expensive wares at the market.

He is an indifferent alchemist, and is far more interested in the art of brewing, but Magaloy is insisting he learn alchemy as well as brewing.

Elixir of Life (Minor).name: Elixir of Life (Minor)
Elixir of Life (Minor).description:
Activate A Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain [[/r 1d6[healing]]]{1d6 Hit Points} and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life (Minor)}

Lady's Blessing Oil.name: Lady's Blessing Oil
Lady's Blessing Oil.description:
Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}

Lady's blessing oil is favored by Pharasmin healers who ease the transitions of life. You can Activate the item as part of the same activity you use to Administer First Aid to stabilize a creature. If you use lady's blessing oil, the DC of the check to Administer First Aid is reduced to the creature's recovery roll DC, rather than 5 + the recovery roll DC. However, if you roll a failure on the check, you get a critical failure instead.

Leaper's Elixir (Lesser).name: Leaper's Elixir (Lesser)
Leaper's Elixir (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 Interact

This tingly solution increases the elasticity and contraction of your leg muscles. For 1 minute after drinking this elixir, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} as a single action instead of 2 actions. If you do, you don't perform the initial Stride (nor do you fail if you don't Stride 10 feet).

Numbing Tonic (Minor).name: Numbing Tonic (Minor)
Numbing Tonic (Minor).description:
Activate 1 Interact

Numbing tonic makes it easier to push through the pain of battle and shrug off otherwise debilitating blows. You gain 2 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.BTWuGksjSU1SYUcf]{Effect: Numbing Tonic (Minor)}

Bloodeye Coffee.name: Bloodeye Coffee
Bloodeye Coffee.description:
A strong blend including several spices common in the Padishah Empire of Kelesh, bloodeye coffee is a favorite morning drink across the Inner Sea region. The maximum addiction stage of bloodeye coffee never progresses beyond stage 1.

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to AC and saves to which you are taking penalties caused by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Stage 3 can't recover from fatigued (1 day, after which the drug ends)

Flayleaf.name: Flayleaf
Flayleaf.description:
The flayleaf plant is relatively common, though the mildly euphoric effects of smoking its dried leaves increase when it's sourced from plants specifically grown to produce such effects.

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects (1 hour)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects (1 hour)

Stage 3 fatigued and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Stage 4 fatigued, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 hour)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 hour)

Smokestick (Lesser).name: Smokestick (Lesser)
Smokestick (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

With a sharp twist of this item, you instantly create a screen of thick, opaque smoke in a burst centered on one corner of your space. All creatures within that area are concealed, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

The radius of the burst is 5 feet.

Sunrod.name: Sunrod
Sunrod.description:
Activate A Interact

This 1-foot-long, gold-tipped rod glows after it's struck on a hard surface. For the next 6 hours, it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet).

Tindertwig.name: Tindertwig
Tindertwig.description:
Activate A Interact

An alchemical substance applied to one end of this tiny wooden stick ignites when struck against a rough surface. Creating a flame with a tindertwig is much faster than creating a flame with flint and steel. You can ignite the tindertwig and touch it to a flammable object as part of the same Interact action.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Drunken Rage.name: Drunken Rage
Drunken Rage.description:
Requirements The drunken brawler isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or raging

Effect The drunken brawler begins raging. They gain 4 temporary Hit Points and deal 1 additional damage with fist Strikes. They have a -1 penalty to AC and can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless those actions also have the rage trait. The drunken brawler can still @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} while in a drunken rage. The rage lasts for 1 minute or until the drunken brawler falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, whichever comes first. When the drunken rage is over, the drunken brawler is fatigued, loses all temporary Hit Points they received from the rage, and cannot rage again for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Effect: Rage}

Improvised Surprise.name: Improvised Surprise
Improvised Surprise.description: The drunken brawler uses an Interact action to pick up an improvised weapon within reach and then Strikes with it. The drunken brawler has a +2 circumstance bonus to this attack.

Durable Farm Clothes.name: Durable Farm Clothes
Durable Farm Clothes.description: This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor or undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep the armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Rapier.name: Rapier
Rapier.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

Flurry of Slaps.name: Flurry of Slaps
Flurry of Slaps.description:
The offended gambler makes two slap Strikes. If both hit the same creature, they combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

The gamblers apply their multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.

Throw Drink.name: Throw Drink
Throw Drink.description: The offended gambler grabs a nearby drink and throws it in the face of a creature within 10 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:15] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for one round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} on a critical failure). On its turn, the affected creature can spend an Interact action to end the dazzled or blinded condition.

Antidote (Lesser).name: Antidote (Lesser)
Antidote (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

An antidote protects you against toxins. Upon drinking an antidote, you gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 6 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7z1iY4AaNEAIKuAU]{Effect: Antidote (Lesser)}

Elixir of Life (Minor).name: Elixir of Life (Minor)
Elixir of Life (Minor).description:
Activate A Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain [[/r 1d6[healing]]]{1d6 Hit Points} and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life (Minor)}

Ruffian.name: Ruffian
Ruffian.publicNotes:
Using their strength to bully others into submission, ruffians often work as bodyguards and enforcers for powerful criminals like charlatans and fences.

Some criminals are the desperate who have no option but to break the law to survive, while others choose a life of crime for thrills, forming gangs or underworld guilds that specialize in certain illegal ventures.

Club.name: Club
Club.description: This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description: Little more than a leather cup attached to a pair of straps, a sling can be used to fling smooth stones or sling bullets at a range.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Sling Bullets.name: Sling Bullets
Sling Bullets.description: These are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

Brutal Beating.name: Brutal Beating
Brutal Beating.description:
The ruffian's brutality shakes foes' confidence.

When the ruffian deals damage on a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and the ruffian can knock the target up to 10 feet away (this is forced movement).

Snagging Strike.name: Snagging Strike
Snagging Strike.description:
Trigger The ruffian has one hand free, and its target is within reach of that hand.

Effect The ruffian makes a melee Strike while keeping one hand free. If this Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of the ruffian's next turn or until it leaves the ruffian's reach, whichever comes first.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
The ruffian deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to off-guard creatures.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SneakAttack]

Bestial Mutagen (Lesser).name: Bestial Mutagen (Lesser)
Bestial Mutagen (Lesser).description:
Activate A Interact

Your features transform into something bestial and you take on muscle mass, but your lumbering form is clumsy.

Benefit You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack ([[/r 1d4[slashing]]] damage) with the agile trait and a jaws unarmed attack ([[/r 1d6[piercing]]] damage).

Drawback You take a -1 penalty to AC and a -2 penalty to Reflex saves.

Duration 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fIpzDpuwLdIS4tW5]{Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Lesser)}
